description: Blocks unsafe git subtree invocations before Bash runs them (PreToolUse).

hooks.command: command -v deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'git-subtrees: deno not found on PATH - install Deno (https://deno.land) so the guard can run' >&2; exit 1; }; exec deno run --quiet "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/guard-git-subtree.ts"
